verses.text: Back then, Israel had no king. Dan’s tribe was still looking for a place to settle, because they hadn’t received their share among Israel’s tribes yet. 🗺️

Dan’s people chose five capable men from Zorah and Eshtaol to scout and explore the land. They told them, ‘Go check out the land!’ The men came to Micah’s house in Ephraim’s hill country and stayed there. 🧭
While near Micah’s house, they recognized the young Levite’s voice. They went over and asked, ‘Who brought you here? What are you doing here? What do you get out of this?’ 👀
He answered, ‘Micah treated me like this and that—he hired me, and now I’m his priest.’ 🗣️
They said, ‘Please ask God if our trip will go well.’ 🙏
The priest told them, ‘Go in peace. Yahweh is watching over the route you’re taking.’ 🕊️

The five men left and reached Laish. They saw a people living securely, like the Sidonians—quiet and confident. No one in the land was in charge to bother them, they were far from Sidon, and had no dealings with anyone else. 🌿
They returned to their relatives in Zorah and Eshtaol, who asked, ‘So, what did you find?’ 🗣️
They said, ‘Get up, let’s go attack them. We’ve seen the land—it’s really good! Why sit around? Don’t drag your feet; go take possession of it. 🗺️
‘When you get there, you’ll find people who aren’t expecting trouble, and the land is wide open. God has given it to you—a place with everything you could need.’ 🙌
Six hundred Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed and ready for war. ⚔️
They went up and camped at Kiriath-Jearim in Judah. That’s why the place is still called Mahaneh-Dan, behind Kiriath-Jearim. 🏕️
From there they continued through Ephraim’s hill country and came to Micah’s house. 🧭
The five men who had scouted Laish told their relatives, ‘Did you know these houses have an ephod, household idols, a carved image, and a metal statue? Think about what you should do.’ 🗿
They went over to the young Levite’s home, inside Micah’s house, and asked how he was doing. 🚪
The six hundred armed Danites stood at the entrance to the gate. 🛡️
The five scouts went in and took the carved image, ephod, household idols, and metal statue. The priest stood at the gate with the six hundred armed men. 🗿
When the scouts took those items from Micah’s house, the priest asked, ‘What are you doing?’ 😮
They told him, ‘Quiet—put your hand over your mouth and come with us. Be a father and priest to us. What’s better: being priest for one man’s household, or for a whole tribe and clan in Israel?’ 🤫
The priest was glad to hear that. He picked up the ephod, household idols, and carved image, then went with them. 🧳
They turned to leave, putting their children, livestock, and belongings out in front of them. 👨‍👩‍👧
After they’d gone some distance from Micah’s house, the neighbors gathered, caught up with the Danites, and called out. 🏃
The Danites turned around and asked Micah, ‘What’s going on? Why are you coming after us with all these people?’ 🗣️
He said, ‘You took my gods that I made and my priest, then left! What do I have now? And you ask me what’s wrong?’ 😠
The Danites warned him, ‘Keep your voice down, or some hotheads may attack you—and you and your family could lose your lives.’ ⚠️
The Danites kept going. Micah realized they were too strong for him, so he turned back home. 🏠
The Danites took the things Micah had made and his priest, reached Laish, and attacked its unsuspecting people with swords. Then they burned the city down. ⚔️
No one came to rescue them because Laish was far from Sidon and had no connection with anyone else. It was in the Beth-Rehob valley. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there. 🏚️
They named the city Dan after their ancestor Dan, who was born to Israel. Before that, it had been called Laish. 🏙️
The Danites set up the carved image for themselves. Jonathan son of Gershom, son of Moses, and his descendants served as priests for Dan’s tribe until the land went into captivity. 🗿
They kept Micah’s carved image for themselves for as long as God’s house was at Shiloh. 🏛️
